{{Quote|What sorcery is this?|[[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]]|<ref name="Nightsisters" />}}
A '''mission''' took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] after [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] ordered his apprentice, [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]], to kill [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. After Ventress survived Dooku's assassination attempt, she sought revenge by going to her fellow [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] for aid. Taking [[Karis/Legends|Karis]] and [[Naa'leth/Legends|Naa'leth]] to Serenno, Ventress attempted to assassinate Dooku, but the Sith Lord repelled the attack, defeating his assailants.

==The mission==
{{Quote|I do not need my eyes to see you, Jedi!|Dooku, mistaking the assailants to be Jedi before attacking them|<ref name="Nightsisters" />}}
[[File:DookuNightsisterClash2-Nightsisters.png|thumb|left|200px|The Nightsisters believe they have Dooku at their mercy]]
Asajj Ventress and her two Nightsisters became [[Water of Life/Legends|invisible]] and infiltrated Tyranus's [[Dooku's palace/Legends|palace]]. Ventress Force-pushed a poison dart into Dooku's neck that blinded him, although he could still sense them through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and mistook them as Jedi. Nontheless, the Count stated that he [[Force sight|did not rely on eyesight alone to detect them]]. With that, Dooku attacked Ventress in a sudden flip jump, beginning a lightsaber duel in the [[Count/Legends|Count's]] bedroom. The other two Nightsisters joined in on the fight when they could, however, the expertise and fluid bladework of the Count kept them separated. Ventress and another went on the offensive while Dooku held a tight defensive through the corridor until eventually it lead into his office. By this point, Dooku was forced between the three at once in his office and despite his efforts was quickly draining his stamina against three opponents at once. Ventress, who had managed to stay disguised during the entire confrontation, managed to disarm the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] by Force pushing him into his desk and was about to strike the killing blow, but Dooku, feigning exhaustion and vulnerability, defended himself by striking Ventress and her accomplices with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], throwing them out the window and over a cliff, ending the attack. However, Ventress broke their falls with her powers, so the three Nightsisters survived and returned to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Where one sees failure, others see opportunity.|Mother [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]|<ref name="Nightsisters" />}}
Due to his attackers' use of Jedi lightsabers, Tyranus mistakenly believed that the Jedi had tried to assassinate him. Wishing to protect himself, he sought a new apprentice to replace Ventress (whom he erroneously believed to be dead).

Given the failure of their direct attempt to kill Tyranus, the Nightsisters developed a new plot to kill the Sith Lord using a double agent. To arrange the plan, [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] contacted Tyranus, offering to provide one of the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] to be his new assassin. Tyranus, seeing this as an opportunity to get the new apprentice he desired, agreed. After selecting [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] to be their pawn, Talzin presented the hulking [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] to Tyranus, who was pleased with his new warrior, unaware of his true loyalties.
